Mira Chen: Heads up — after yesterday's kernel-picker change (use heuristics v2), we're seeing a 12–18% p99 tail increase on 8xA100 runs for batch=4 chat workloads. nvprof/nsys traces attached? Anyone else? :frowning_face:

Alex Park: saw similar on nightly. p50 fine, p99 spikes when cache hits are low. suspect batch coalescing picks large-kernel path too often.

Samir Patel: can you paste the nsys command you ran? I'll re-run with NCCL tracing enabled.

Mira Chen: ran:
```
nsys profile -o trace_v2 --sample=none --trace=cuda,cublas,nvtx,nccl --capture-range=nvtx:begin:nvtx:end -- ./run_inference --model t5-xxl --gpus 8 --batch 4
```
Got a 1.3s allreduce gap between pipeline stages on rank 3-4

Kevin O'Leary: quick glance at perfetto shows KV cache retire spikes around the same times — likely serialization of KV writes. Might be our KV retire fence on kernel-switch. cc @Alex

Alex Park: repro trace snippet (simplified):
```
KernelSelect::choose() -> conv_fwd_optimized (seq_len=256)
kv_store_retire fence()
AllReduce N=128 delay 1.2ms
```
I think kernel switch causes extra synchronization that prevents overlapping allreduce/batched decoder kernels.

perf-bot: perf regression alert: nightly-2026-03-12 -> +14% p99 on eng-runtime/long-context-chat (8gpu)

Samir Patel: I'll run an nvprof capture for single iteration with `--trace-nccl` then diff against v1

Mira Chen: attaching screenshots? can't attach here but paste top timeline summary:
- Decoder kernels: continuous but shorter
- KV retire: big blocking kernel at 00:12:34.456
- NCCL allreduce: queued, waits 900us before start

Alex Park: hypothesis: heuristic v2 picks quantized-kernel variant that uses a different workspace layout -> triggers KV cache reformat on first use -> that calls synchronous copy+retire. Solution: make reformat async+buffer or prefer kernel variant with same KV layout for warm-starts.

Kevin O'Leary: can we add a metric in runtime to count `KV_REFORMAT` occurrences per request? If we can route requests with warm cache to the no-reformat path we can avoid spikes.

Samir Patel: re-run commands and will upload nsys + perfetto links. For now, check nccl timeline excerpt I posted:
```
# NCCL timeline (ranks 0..7)
rank3: send 0.12ms | wait 1.2ms | start allreduce
rank4: send 0.13ms | wait 1.21ms | start allreduce
```

Mira Chen: thanks. Plan: (1) add KV_REFORMAT telemetry, (2) change kernel-picker fallback to prefer layout-compatible kernels when cache miss rate >30%, (3) run canary with 4 test runs. I'll open PR. :thumbsup: 

Alex Park: ping me on PR, will add async reformat patch attempt.

deploy-bot: canary started on dedicated-pool-2 (8xA100) for commit abc1234

Mira Chen: closing loop — will post final perf numbers after canary completes.
